title: DoT KYC: number to be disconnected, then 'cyber police'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is an automated call from the Department of Telecommunications. Your mobile number will be disconnected in two hours. Press nine to speak to an officer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, I am officer Rakesh Verma from the DoT enforcement wing. A second SIM taken on your Aadhaar was used to send fraud messages.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: I don't have any second SIM.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That is why we are connecting you to the cyber police headquarters. Please stay on the line and do not disconnect, otherwise a case is registered automatically.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is sub inspector Kadam, cyber police. To clear your name you must install the verification app I am sending and share your screen.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: There is also a clearance fee of 18,500 rupees. Pay it now on the link and your number will stay active.
